caption:
Some climbs in Costa Rica are meant to be ridden, and some are meant to be walked with your bike beside you. When the grade kicks up past thirty percent and the grass turns soft under yesterday’s rain, there is no shame in getting off the saddle. You drop your shoulders, lean into the handlebars, and take the mountain one quiet step at a time. The ridge waiting at the top is always worth the honest work.
